entities.summary: Hans Marchwitza was a German communist revolutionary, proletarian writer and poet. A miner by trade and a veteran of the First World War, he fought in the Ruhr Red Army during the Ruhr Uprising and the International Brigades during the Spanish Civil War. He was later a prominent cultural figure in East Germany.
